x-t0-Lima-r1.original: 120 total is respectable given a 0-point round one, but it's roughly half of what the kitchen should allow — in solo practice I managed 3 soups in 120 s, so a well-run 180 s round should give 4–5 soups. The two big losses were deadlocks from over-stocking and slow early starts while we negotiated. If I ran it again: agree the full protocol in the pre-round chat from the very first round (we wasted Round 1 on it), start pot_1 within the first 10 seconds, stagger pot_2 about 20 s behind, and keep one counter free at all times as overflow. The core lesson: in a no-drop/no-swap system, counter inventory is the bottleneck — never saturate it, and never hold an item you don't have a committed destination for.
